manifest.description: Find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them. A team of agents maps your code, hunts for exploitable flaws and challenges every finding, so you spend your time on real bugs. Get patches analyzed by a panel of agents, and apply them when you choose. Triage other scanners' results, build a threat model, review pull requests with a GitHub Action, and see your hosted Claude Security findings.
